Organic Absorption

Imhotep (The Mummy) absorbing the organic substance to become whole.

Power/Ability to:

Absorb organic substances.

The power to absorb organic substances and utilize it in some way. Technique of Organic Manipulation. Variation of Absorption.

Also Called[]

  • Organic Assimilation

Capabilities[]

The user can absorb organic substances, while removing them from the source, into their body and use it in various ways, gaining some form of advantage, either by enhancing themselves, gaining the drained power, using it as a power source, etc., either temporarily or permanently.

Applications[]

  • Assimilation Shield
  • Organic Empowerment
    • Organic Consumption
  • Organic Regeneration
  • Peak Human/Enhanced/Supernatural Condition

Variations[]

  • Asphalt Absorption
  • Biological Absorption
    • Flesh Absorption
  • Blood Absorption
  • Bone Absorption
  • Brain Absorption
  • Carbon Absorption
  • DNA Absorption
  • Milk Absorption
  • Nutrient Absorption
  • Poison Absorption
  • Wood Absorption

Associations[]

  • Absorption
  • Organic Manipulation

Limitations[]

  • May be limited to how much one can absorb.
  • May have limited range, including touch only.
  • Absorption Immunity/Absorption Negation

Gallery[]

The Type-042 or Necrogolem (Anima: Beyond Fantasy) can absorb and assimilate organic beings in order to increase its destructive capabilities.
Ghotas (Alien Trespass) absorb their victims' nutrients until the victim is nothing but a puddle of residue.
The Millennium Earl (D.Gray-Man) devours the "helix of life", or one's soul, from Danny, causing him to disintegrate.
Majin Buu (Dragon Ball Z)
The Thing Monster (John Carpenter's The Thing)
Naraku (InuYasha) absorbed flesh of several demons to take on his more powerful forms, including a demonic tree and a demon turtle's shell.
Vinsmoke Reiju (One Piece) can absorb organic toxins such as the poison of a venomous Armored Stonefish into herself.
Yveltal (Pokémon)
Squee-Gs (Splatoon) automatically absorb organic matter, specifically ink, as they move.
Incubus (DC Extended Universe) absorbs other people into his host's body to reach his full potential.
Wasp Spider (Kanokon) bonded together wither Chizuru’s body, making it seem impossible to remove the bunny outfit.
Peacekeeper (Astro Boy)
Krang and his siblings (Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Movie) are able to mutate without their mutagen living and nonliving things into Krang hybrids, also known as Krang Zombies, which they control.
Dalek Sec (Doctor Who)
